m: शिपाटक m. N. of a man, Rājat.
शिपवित्नुक m. a kind of worm, AV.

s: puM, raSmiH । yaTA, -- “SEtyAt SayanayogAcca SipivAri pracakzate । tatpAnAdrakzaRAMccEva Sipayo raSmayo matAH । tezu praveSAt viSveSaH Sipivizwa ihocyate ॥” iti vyAsavanam ॥
v: pu॰ SI--kvip tAM pAti pA--ki pfzo॰ hrasvaH । 1 raSmO 2 jale na॰ “SEtyAt SayanayogAcca Sipi vAri pracakzate । tat pAnAdrakzaRAccEva Sipayo raSmayo matA । tezu praveSAt viSveSaH Sipivizwa ihocyate” vyAsaH ।
m: शिपि m. a ray of light, Nir. v, 8
a: शिपिः — A ray of light. --f. Skin, leather. --n. Water; शैत्याच्छयनयागोच्च शिपि वारि प्रचक्षते Vyāsa. --Comp. --विष्ट a. (written शिपविपष्ट or शिविपष्ट also) {1} pervaded by rays. {2} bald, bald-headed. {3} leprous. --(ष्टः) {1} an epithet of Viṣṇu. {2} of Śiva. {3} a bald man. {4} a man without prepuce. {5} a leper.

s: puM, KalatiH । duScarmmA । maheSvaraH । ityamaraH ॥ kuzWI । ityamarawIkAyAM rAyamukuwaH ॥ asya rUpAntaram । SipavizwaH । SipivizwaH । ityamarawIkA ॥ vizRuH yaTA, -- “nEkarUpI bfhadrupaH SipivizwaH prakASanaH ॥” iti tasya sahasranAmastotraM ramAnATaSca ॥ (paSupravizwe, tri । yaTA, BAgavate । 4 । 13 । 35 । “puroqASaM niravapan SipivizwAya vizRave ॥” “Sipizu paSuzu yajYarUpeRa pravizwAya । taTAca SrutiH yajYo vE vizRuH paSavaH SipiH yajYa eva paSuzu pratitizWatIti .” iti SrIDarasvAmI ॥)
v: pu॰ 7 ta॰ । 1 KalatO 2 duScarmaRi ca 3 maheSvare amaraH । 4 vizRO SipiSabde dfSyam । “nekarUpo vfhadrUpaH Sipivizwa prakASanaH” vizRusa॰ । pfzo॰ Sizavizwa tatrArTe ramAnATaH ।
m: शिपि—विष्ट mfn. (accord. to Sāy.) pervaded by rays (applied to Rudra-Śiva and Viṣṇu; cf. RTL. 416), RV. &c. &c.

s: strI, nadIviSezaH । yaTA, -- “tato himavataH prasTe pratIcyAM tatpurasya ca । Sipra nAmaM saraH pUrRaM dadfSurdruhiRAdayaH ॥ tadrahasTAnamAsAdya brahmaSakrAdayaH surAH । upavizwA yaTAnyAyaM puraskftya maheSvaram ॥ taM SiprasaMjYakAsAraM manojYaM sarvvadehinAm । SItAmalajalaM sarvvErguRErmAnasasammitam ॥ dfzwvA kzaRaM harastasmin sOtsuko'BUdavekzaRe । SiprAM nAma nadIM tasmAnniHsftAM dakziRodaDim । gacCantIYca dadarSAsO pAvayantIM jagajjanAn ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 19 aDyAyaH ॥ (hanuH । yaTA, fgvede । 8 । 65 । 10 । “uttizWannojasA saha pItvI Sipre avepayaH .” “Sipre hanU .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥)
a: शिप्रा — 1 N. of a river which issues from the Sipra lake and on the bank of which stands Ujjayinī; शिप्रावातः प्रियतम इव प्रार्थनाच टुकारः Me. 81. --2 A visor or helmet.

s: puM, sarovaraviSezaH । yaTA, -- “evaM vivAhya viDivat sOvarRe mAnasAcale । arunDatIM vaSizWastu modamApa tayA saha ॥ tatra yat patitaM toyaM mAnasAcalakandare । vivAhAvaBftArTAya SAntyarTaM vasuDAkftam ॥ brahmavizRumahAdevapARiBiH samudIritam । tattoyaM saptaDA BUtvA patitaM mAnasAcalAt ॥ hemAdreH kandare sAnO sarasyAYca pfTak pfTak । tattoyaM patitaM Sipre devaBogye sarovare । tena SiprA nadI jAtA vizRunA preritA kzitim ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 23 aDyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ Si--rak puk ca । 1 sarovaraBede 2 padIBede strI । “evaM vivAhya viDivat sOvarRe mAnasAcale । arunTatIM vaSizWastu modamApa tayA saha । tatra yat patitaM toyaM mAnasAcalakandare vivAhAvaBftArTAya SAntyarTaM vasuDAtale । brahmavizRumahAdevapARiBiH samudIritam । tattIya saptaDA BUtvA patitaM mAnasAcayAt । himAdreH kandara sAnO sarasyAYca pfTak pfTak । tatIyaM patita Sipre devaBogye sarovare । tena SiprA nadI jAtA vizRunA preritA kitim” kAliKA॰ 23 a॰ । “tato himavataH prasTe pratIcyAM tatpurasya ca । SipraM nAma saraH pUrRaM dadfSurdruhiRAdayaH । tadrahaH sTAnamAmAdya brahmaSakAdaya sarAH । upavizwaH yaTAnyAkaM suraskftya maheSvaram । taM SiprasaMjYakAsAraM manojYaM savadehinAm । SotAmalajala sarvErguRErmAnasasAmsatam । dfzwvA kzaRa harastasmin sOtsukyo'BUdavekzaRe । SiprAM nAma nadIM tasmAnniHsftA dakziRodaDim । gacCantIYca dadarSAsO pAvayantIM jagajjanAn” । tatrEva 19 a॰ ।
a: शिप्रः — N. of a lake on the Himālaya. --प्रं Ved. 1 A cheek; jaw. --2 The chin. --3 The nose. --4 A helmet or visor.

m: शिप्रक m. N. of the murderer of Su-śarman, VP.
of the first king of the Āndhras, MW.
शिप्र—वत् (शिप्र-), mfn. having full cheeks, full-cheeked, RV. vi, 17, 2.
शिप्रिणी-वत् and शिप्रिन्, mfn. full-cheeked, RV.
